Gets the affected device(s) associated with an alert in conjunction with provided filters viz
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/alerts/:alert_id/affected_devices

Gets the affected device(s) associated with an alert in conjunction with provided filters viz., impacted department, locations and geolocation. Alert Id needs to provided as path parameter.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
alert_id
string
REQUIRED
QUERY PARAMETERS
dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

offset
string

The next_offset value from the last request. You must enter this value to get the next batch from the list. When the next_offset value becomes null, the list is complete.

limit
integer

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 10000

The number of items that must be returned per request from the list.

Default value: 1000
location groups
integer[]

The location group id. You can add multiple location group IDs.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
devices
object[]
next_offset
string

This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.
